newsitem.title: ALBANIA: 20 injured in arms depot explosion in Albania.
newsitem.headline: 20 injured in arms depot explosion in Albania.

text.p: Teenage vandals injured 20 people by blowing up at an arms depot in north-west Albania, the Albanian news agency ATA reported on Friday.

Police sources told ATA that two or three teenagers tried to snatch explosives on Thursday from the depot, which is in the village of Gryke Manat near Lezhe 65 km (40 miles) north of Tirana. They were chased off by guards but retaliated by throwing burning cans and bottles into the depot, triggering the explosion. A number of buildings were damaged but no deaths were reported.
Arsenals have been looted in two months of chaos in Albania in which more than 300 people have died.
